en-US.author: Northbit
en-US.description: Turn raw AI Markdown and MDX into presentation-ready HTML documents.
en-US.longDescription:
Prisment is a local-first documentation workspace for rendering, editing, reviewing, and exporting Markdown, MDX, Mermaid, KaTeX, PDF, Word, Excel, and related project files.
Document content and file names remain on the device. The desktop app sends anonymous aggregate usage data—a daily active signal, OS, app version, and coarse country-level location—which can be disabled from the Help menu.
en-US.name: Prisment
